guitar.notes: Garbage's guitar parts are shared/programmed-heavy; no single iconic instrument widely documented.

tone.target: dirty alt-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: dirty alt-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A mid-gain, slightly dirty signal chain utilizing a classic British amp tone (UK 45/50) combined with Chorus and a focused EQ to achieve the required alt-rock sheen and punchy rhythm.
corrections: make chorus part of the core tone

rig.name: Garbage - Only Happy When It Rains - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide the initial gritty crunch and mid-range push.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a classic, slightly broken tube preamp sound suitable for alt-rock grit.

alternatives.reason: Similar dirt boost, but Green OD often has better mid-range focus.

blocks.purpose: Subtle saturation to thicken the low mids without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is kept subtle (low drive) to add grit without crossing into 'heavy fuzz' territory, fulfilling the 'dirty crunch' requirement.

alternatives.reason: A more general option if the RAT tone is too aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Apply the required 'chorus sheen' and width to the rhythm tone.
Provide the core British alt-rock tone and punchy mid-range.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is ideal for classic, slightly dirty rhythm tones that emphasize mids without being overly aggressive like a Recti or too clean like US Deluxe.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if the tone needs to be slightly more open/airy.

blocks.purpose: Ground the tone with a classic British cabinet sound.
Sculpt the tone to emphasize 'thick low mids' and maintain punchiness.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical EQ adjustments, focusing on the fundamental frequencies of alt-rock rhythm guitar.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space during non-rhythmic sections (optional).
blocks.gap: The delay is kept optional/low mix to maintain the 'punchy and dry-ish' feel, only adding ambience when needed.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle natural ambience without sounding overly wet or distant.
blocks.gap: A moderate Room reverb provides space while keeping the core rhythm tone dry and punchy.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic British alt-rock sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the classic UK/British tone and punchiness required for alt-rock.
